pages.text: $(l)Waystones$() spawn in villages and can be crafted. Activate one and you can teleport back to it from any other waystone, or with a Warp Scroll / Warp Stone.$(br2)Press $(l)M$() for the full world map. Press $(l)N$() to drop a waypoint, $(l)U$() to list them.

$(l)The Aether$(): build a portal frame out of $(l)glowstone$() (same shape as a Nether portal) and light it with a $(l)water bucket$(). Floating islands, sky dungeons, flying mounts.$(br2)Enter it for the $(o)Touch Clouds$() advancement.
